title: Round3 actual Electron Speed editing and timeline observations

method.preference: Verified default Speed and zero failed warmups in every fresh profile
method.timed: Actual click to success, closed dialog, cleared waveform pending state, successful canvas paint and two animation frames; menu/fixture/startup excluded
method.warm: Trial 0 is first use; trials 1 and 2 are warm. Warm medians are arithmetic median of six observations per variant; later profiles have four per variant. First-use observations stay separate.
method.host: Shared Ryzen 9 9900X WSL host. Software/Xvfb renderer; canonical/browser checks ran during current and later baseline profiles on bounded CPU subsets. No throttling or affinity was applied to Electron. First baseline metadata predates added host snapshots, so exact host-start data is unavailable for that profile.
method.followup: After initial ABBA profiles, an additional baseline/current pair was collected to inspect substantial host/memory/load drift. Every original observation is retained; later-profile summaries expose the drift without silently discarding it.
method.timeline: Animation-frame scheduling is a renderer proxy, not presented GPU FPS. Each idle/play/scroll sample spans about 3 seconds; actual playback movement and trusted pointer/wheel movement are asserted.
method.limits: This is diagnostic shared-host evidence, not a controlled statistical or per-item causal latency experiment. Small sample counts, JIT/GC/I/O/audio scheduling and concurrent processes remain uncontrolled. No universal speedup or timeline FPS improvement is claimed.

runs.label: baseline-1
runs.method: Actual Electron development app with freshly staged production renderer and real preload/SQLite/PCM path. First trial includes first-use processing engines; subsequent trials are warm. Capture click to dialog closed, success status, cleared waveform pending state, explicit successful canvas paint and two animation frames. Xvfb RAF gaps are a renderer responsiveness proxy, not GPU presentation FPS. Startup excluded.
